scope: Filesystem-only catalog, manifest, release-wiring, and authored-artifact QA. No Blender or visual approval.

findings.subject: Runtime release snapshot is empty
evidence: src/data/yachts/release.json has null repository and revision and an empty vessels array.
src/assets/yachts.ts imports only release.vessels for authored yacht admission.
No public/yacht-assets tree was found; output/yachts/catalog is not runtime admission.

findings.subject: Seed/catalog publication gate remains incomplete
evidence: The 172-row seed evaluates to 6 canonical and 166 unresolved rows under current dispositions.
The current disposition file is Princess-only; no Sunseeker disposition file exists.
scripts/yachts/quality.ts treats every unresolved seed row as a collection failure.

findings.subject: Hawk 38 canonical has no raw seed row
evidence: Seven Sunseeker batch targets have raw rows 18, 20, 26, 28, 37, 71, and 85.
No Hawk 38 row exists in research/sunseeker-princess-yacht-range.md.
Potential namesakes and other generations remain unassigned rather than forced.

findings.subject: Princess V55 lacks independent quality approval
evidence: The exported V55 manifest parses with 34 components, 25 meaningful components, 6 assets, 3 decks, 10 rooms, and 12 cameras.
All 6 manifest asset byte counts and SHA-256 values match filesystem bytes.
technical-review.json reports visualReview=pending and publicationReady=false.
No .tools/yachts/review/princess-v55-gen2-2019/quality.json exists.

findings.subject: Sunseeker exchange is stale
evidence: The three exchange GLBs are readable and their declared assembly owners are inspectable.
The current Sunseeker master SHA-256 does not match exchange/authoring.json.masterSha256.
scripts/yachts/export.ts rejects stale exchanges before optimization.
The Sunseeker scene report has an empty assets array and inspection-required status.

findings.subject: Sunseeker has no exported manifest, technical review, or quality review
evidence: No assets/models/sunseeker-superhawk-55-gen1-2023/manifest.json exists.
No assets/models/sunseeker-superhawk-55-gen1-2023/technical-review.json exists.
No review quality.json exists for Sunseeker or V55.

findings.subject: Visual quality is not approved
evidence: Metadata establishes export structure and dimensional checks only.
The prior Sunseeker render review rejected flat-box roof, open-hull, protruding-room, and cropped-view results; producer revision remains required.
No independent quality review artifact is present.

postMcpChecks: Regenerate the exchange from the current master and require matching master SHA-256.
Run the exporter and require version-2 manifest, both exterior LODs, complete component coverage, embedded GLBs, safe paths, and matching bytes/SHA-256.
Compare exported V55 and Superhawk length/beam/draft against research targets within the project tolerance.
Create independent quality.json files and require reviewFailures(manifest, review) to return an empty array.
Recheck Sunseeker silhouette, hull closure, room containment, and camera framing in fresh renders.
Keep release.json empty until catalog, dispositions, approved reviews, and pinned repository/revision are complete.
